item.title: Steve ‘Zoom’ Hopkins
item.description: Steve Hopkins, passed away peacefully on Thursday 22nd January 2026 at Richard House Care Home, Grantham, aged 73 years. Steve was well known throughout the town for his connection to the motor trade and the Institute of Advanced Motoring.
